technology_name: MICROHEATERS DESIGN AND FABRICATON USING TWO-STEP LASER GRAPHITIZATION METHOD FOR SUPERIOR THERMAL PERFORMANCE AND DURABILITY
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Traditional microheaters rely on expensive metal-deposition cleanroom processing steps that exhibit poor structural durability and face trace delamination failure at high open-air temperatures.
description: A low-cost, multi-environment durable microheater array fabricated via a streamlined two-step laser graphitization method that achieves stable operating metrics exceeding 405°C in open air and up to 500°C in inert settings.
applications: Microfluidic lab-on-a-chip thermal blocks, smart wearable sensor heating strips, aerospace component de-icing micro-grids, and gas sensor activation setups.
secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, MedTech & Health Care, Consumer & Lifestyle Products
